usage.finalMessage:
I added `quote <customer> <amount>`, which gives a date 21 days after today under DEC-B12. It's listed in `help` directly after `invoice`, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (9 tests, 0 failed). The work, decision records and report are committed.
Open question: issuing an invoice still uses the superseded 30-day rule (DEC-B01), so a quote's date differs from the due date a real invoice gets. I kept the 30-day rule because BILL-41 says existing behaviour must not change and an existing test checks for 30 days. Moving invoices to 21 days needs Finance's approval.

OUTCOME: completed
